title: A release covers less than the one before
assertion: Assembly and the checker refuse a release that stops covering a code and date its previous release covered, unless the dates are older than the six-year look-back or closed by the source's own dates (each listed in COVERAGE.md) or withdrawn by a note two different people signed; a listed entry that is no loss, a stale or misdated note, and a missing or unreadable previous release, or one whose files are not those its manifest seals, are refused; a date counts as closed by the source only when the closing record's quoted row states it; the drafts note's entries are copied into the release's COVERAGE.md and the note is removed
noFileReason: Two numbered releases are written to a temporary root; no file.
